name: buttons-chunk1219
note: Button slots, name lookup, and axis clamp from c_buttons.cpp (1-316).
auditSeams: The double-click bit is masked with 0x7FFF. Key 0 is the console force path. FName lookup is ASCII case-fold and no-create, so None and an unknown name both return -1. Duplicate names keep the later index. CheckWildcards, key bindings, and the axis table are caller-supplied. The 32-byte matcher keeps 31 characters while the printed command uses the full name. A name longer than 14 characters overflows the native 16-byte strcpy and the port passes the full name.
auditRationale: UNCredited c_buttons.cpp 1-316 (+316). The file ends at 316. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
